descriptions.preferred: This outstanding dissectum differs from others of its type in its deep color and individual leaf shape. The leaves are large for a dissectum, with lobes up to 10 cm long. The basal lobes point backward. The entire sevenlobed leaf measures as much as 15 cm long and wide. Each lobe ends in a fine tip. The lobes measure less than 1 mm at the tip, broadening to 3 cm in the middle, and Corvallis of other dissectums. The bright red petioles are 4 cm long. The leaves develop a deep tone of purple red as they grow in the spring and retain the deep color all season. They do not bronze out in late season as do other reds. sources.title: 稻叶枝垂 Acer Palmatum 'Inaba Shidare'
sources.description: 想要在花园里面获得难以置信的体验，请在你的群植搭配里面尝试一下稻叶枝垂。这种羽毛枫在其优美的枝干上有着非常精致的叶子。最早于1882年在《械品便览》里有记载。它在春天绽放出深紫红色的叶子，在夏天变成古铜色。当秋天到来时，由于昼夜温差使树叶呈现出明亮的火红色。和大多数羽毛枫一样，夏天需要及时遮荫，成年树高约2米。

sources.name: Inaba Shirdare Red Lace Leaf Japanese Maple
sources.description: Inaba shirdare is known for its persistence of deep tone of purple-red foliage color throughout the entire growing season. Fall colors turn to a crimson tone. It has cascading form and grows a little taller than most lace leaf maples. They reach about 12 feet high, and 12 ft wide. Hardy to minus 15 fine in high temps and humidity, you can not go wrong with this variety.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一出色的细裂叶品种与同类不同之处，在于其深浓的叶色和独特的叶形。对细裂叶类而言，其叶片较大，裂片最长可达 10 厘米，基部裂片向后反卷。整张 7 裂叶的长和宽都可达 15 厘米。每个裂片末端都有细尖，裂片顶端宽不足 1 毫米，中部渐宽至 3 厘米，比其他细裂叶品种更宽厚。鲜红色叶柄长约 4 厘米。春季展叶时即呈深紫红色，整个生长季都能保持这种浓色，不会像其他红叶品种那样在季末转为古铜色。高温烈日下若植株偏干，叶尖可能会灼伤。秋色极为艳丽，由紫红转为深绯红色。'Inaba shidare' 可视为 'Palmatifidum' 的红叶对应品种。对细裂叶类型而言，'Inaba shidare' 算是较为直立的生长型，虽有下垂姿态，但整体观感略更挺立。它生长健壮、枝条结实，不像某些细裂叶品种那样枝条过于纤细脆弱。虽然目前栽培中尚不算常见，但随着在美国被更多认识，应会成为受欢迎的园林品种。该品种自 19 世纪中期起便见载于日本文献。其名称也体现了日本命名的趣味：日本人观察到此树在雨中略像 ine（“稻株”），而某种古老形式在秋季会转为深红色，因此 inaba 可理解为“似稻叶”；shidare 意为“垂枝”。合起来，'Inaba shidare' 即“垂枝稻叶”。

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜种植于排水良好且不易干燥的土壤中。夏季必要时应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。叶缘焦枯通常由土壤缺水或暴晒过度引起。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Inaba shidare' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Inaba shidare' Weeping Red Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Inaba shidare’ is an excellent weeping red Japanese maple. This red laceleaf Japanese maple cultivar is pendulous but with a very arching effect. The leaf is medium sized and leafs out with brilliant shades of deep burgundy and maroon. The fall color is a scarlet red. ‘Inaba shidare’ is a very vigorous grower. This weeping red Japanese maple tree grows great in full sun and can handle partial shade areas though the color maintains better with at least a 3-4 hours of sunlight. This laceleaf Japanese maple tree grows slightly wider than it does tall as it will reach 5 ft by 6 ft wide in about 10 years. This red laceleaf Japanese maple is very hardy and adapts well to almost any situation. Inaba shidare is an excellent patio plant and the growth lends itself well to large container growing. ‘Inaba shidare’ is one of the very best choices for a medium sized cascading red. The growth and shape make it the quintessential Japanese maple cultivar for any location.
